notes: Recheck after ip#271 of the W2-C2 finding (ip#268). The document now says the gate refuses a setup whose [gold] and [gate] sections hold identical command lists, that [script] lines are shared and not part of that comparison, and that two sides reading the same file with different commands are accepted. All three hold at equivalence.py:87-93, which compares commands['gold'] with commands['gate'] before the shared script lines are added.

Run (PYTHONPATH=src, setup_files on four setups in a temporary folder): identical [gold] and [gate] scripts gave 'reads gold and gate with the same script, so it compares a design with itself (refused, nothing ran)'; gold and gate both reading d.v with an extra 'flatten' on the gate side gave sides {'gold': ['d.v'], 'gate': ['d.v']} and no problem; a setup with the scripts only under [script] and empty [gold] and [gate] gave the 'needs a [gold] and a [gate] section' refusal; the same read in both sections with the shared prep under [script] was refused as the same script.
The gate compares split command words, so whitespace and comment differences do not make two scripts different. The document does not claim otherwise.

parse_eqy: a pass needs eqy exit 0, DONE (PASS), 'Successfully proved designs equivalent', at least one proved partition and none failed; a PASS with no partition proved gets the summary 'no partition was proved'; the summary names the gate and gold files and 'n of total' partitions (eda_parsers.py:496-505). The EQY pages hold what the document tags: the sat and sby strategy text, safe-replacement refinement, three-valued gold and two-valued gate, and the shifter bug trace (six bits instead of five).

Tag reading: 'matches signals by name' is a fair reading of the [match] section text (rules for matching net names of gold to gate) rather than a sentence of the page; the document pairs it with [EqyQuick] and the partition text, and it is not a gate claim.

gate_claims.claim: equivalence.run takes the setup in eqy and optionally the RTL it must read in sources
a setup is refused, nothing runs, when a script line reaches outside Yosys (a shell, exec, tcl, python, script, plugin)
a script that writes a file (write_*, tee, dump) is refused
a setup with no [gold] or no [gate] section is refused
the gate refuses a setup whose [gold] and [gate] sections hold identical command lists (checked by running setup_files)
[script] lines are shared by both sides and are not part of the identical-script comparison
two sides that read the same file with different commands are accepted (checked by running setup_files)
a read by an absolute path or outside the setup's own folder is refused
a read of a file that is not there is refused
given sources, the setup must read every one of them, compared by resolved path
the run copies the setup and the files it reads into its own directory, and records the files each side read
a run passes only when eqy exited 0, said DONE (PASS), proved the designs equivalent, proved at least one partition and failed none
a setup that proves no partition fails and the summary says that nothing was proved
a partition not proved fails the run and the summary names the first partition
the result names the gold and the gate files and the partition count
the gate counts partitions, not outputs
the tool is available, so the document opens with Practising
tests that pin the refusals (outside Yosys, writes, outside the folder, a design compared with itself) and the unread source
